data.name: YTKillerPlus
data.subtitle: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls
data.localizedDescription: YTKillerPlus is an advanced feature-packed YouTube tweak by iKarwan. It offers comprehensive ad blocking, background playback, high-speed downloads, PiP, custom player actions, OLED dark theme, and granular privacy controls.
data.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.37.4 | YTKillerPlus_21.37.4_6.1

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

- **Cracked by** [u/lowiqentity](https://www.reddit.com/user/lowiqentity/)

> [!NOTE]
> - **Sidestore is no longer supported!!.**
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K is available for A16+ devices.
> - use **YTKACE or any other mod** for downloading. dev intentionally broke download feature.
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino`  `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!WARNING]
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.

compatibility.notes: The developer's own AltStore source (repo.ikghd.me) has been unreachable, so this feed resolves from the ready-to-sideload community build of the official tweak at mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA. YouTube 21.34+ requires iOS 17. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
